cards.text: Begin with raw natural audio and footage of a climber attempting a wall move and falling.
Purpose & Mood: Establishes a candid, grounded tone and introduces the theme of youthful attempts and physical memories.

cards.notes: Trim source from 20.9s to 18s to fit the beat duration.

cards.text: Cut directly to the intimate gathering of a woman sharing an animated story on a couch surrounded by laughter.
Purpose & Mood: Builds emotional warmth, highlighting close bonds and quiet, reflective peace.
As this clip begins, introduce the delicate classical piano sound from the grand piano performance to score the scene with bittersweet nostalgia.

cards.notes: Trim source from 35.2s to 24s to capture the best singing moments.

cards.text: Transition into the memory of friends enthusiastically singing Christmas karaoke together in a living room.
Purpose & Mood: Captures uninhibited joy and togetherness, serving as the emotional peak of the high school memory sequence.

cards.notes: Play music bed under the karaoke scene.

cards.text: Blend the karaoke audio softly underneath the reflective music bed of "Ivy" to enhance the sense of time passing.
Conclude the piece with a friend attempting a cartwheel and tumbling playfully to the floor amidst dialogue and laughter.
Purpose & Mood: Delivers a lighthearted, bittersweet farewell that leaves the viewer with a sense of comfort and fond reflection.
Let the final laughter and gentle music trail off into silence over a slow fade to black.
